events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: YEPODA K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora Meatpacking
events.what_it_is: A YEPODA K-beauty pop-up outside Sephora Meatpacking with product try-ons, free gifts and prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Attendance is free with no purchase necessary. The listing advertises exclusive free gifts while supplies last and chances to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Gift-with-purchase offers at $40+ or $60+ are separate from the no-purchase-needed attendance/freebie offer.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 12 PM–6 PM, on 13th Street in front of Sephora Meatpacking. The event listing explicitly says no purchase is necessary to attend and receive freebies.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum × Macy's Sampling Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A one-day outdoor sampling activation at Macy's Herald Square Plaza celebrating the launch of Max Mara Le Parfum.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato and fragrance samples are advertised, plus a chance to win special giveaways, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Samples, gelato and giveaways are while supplies last. The source's calendar header shows 9 AM, but its detailed event copy explicitly gives the activation hours as 10 AM–6 PM; the tracker uses the detailed hours rather than the generic header time.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy's Herald Square Plaza, 151 W 34th St.

occurrences.details: Walk-in public pop-up; no purchase necessary to attend and receive advertised freebies while supplies last.
Walk-in sampling activation with complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and giveaway opportunities while supplies last.
